free_tier.stated: Standard free package: 'IPFS Storage: 6 GB/month', 'Arweave Storage: Total 100 MB', 'Bandwidth: 10 GB/month', resets on the 1st. Separate 7-day Trial: 1 GB IPFS, 10 MB Arweave, 1 GB bandwidth.

egress.terms: metered at 10 GB/month on the free Standard package, then $0.1/GB pay-as-you-go. Not free.

tooling: 'Bucket API - S3 Compatible ... fully compatible with the Amazon S3 Cloud Storage service' — AWS SDKs for Go/Java/JS/.NET/PHP/Python/Ruby all documented.
chaining: 6 GB/month resets monthly, and the free package is 'Unconditional' for Standard but requires 'on-chain identity registration and account activation'. Unlimited accounts x 6 GB with monthly reset means chained accounts can hold a rolling 6 GB each, not accumulate.
limits_note: per-object-cap: none stated. bandwidth-cap: 10 GB/month egress is the binding limit, and it is far below any useful serving volume. retention: storage is rented per second (ipfs_fee = X * unit_price * Time), so it decays with balance. Free package resets rather than accumulates.

evidence.proved: probe: DNS for ipfs.4everland.io and <cid>.ipfs.4everland.io -> NXDOMAIN (gateway hostnames do not resolve from here)
